name: POST /api/leadflow/templates/:id/publish - the approval gate on going live
description:
Publishes one version behind the approval gate (8cc092ee-0c9c-4805-8c72-ebc30d20d7d8#AC2).

ONLY REVOPS MAY PUBLISH. A Rep may USE approved copy and may not alter it - a rep who edits a template changes what every other rep sends without anybody reviewing it, which is how an unapproved claim reaches a thousand prospects. The refusal is 403 naming the role.

THE ROLE IS CHECKED BEFORE THE VERSION EXISTS. Checking the version first would tell a Rep whether a draft exists, which is information they have no claim on and a hint about copy they may not change.

EXACTLY ONE CTA, checked at publish and enforced by a CHECK constraint on the version row (8cc092ee-0c9c-4805-8c72-ebc30d20d7d8#AC4). Belt and braces because the failure is silent: a two-CTA message does not error, it just converts worse, and nobody attributes that to the template.

FEATURE-STATUS HONESTY IS CHECKED AT PUBLISH, NOT AT AUTHORING (8cc092ee-0c9c-4805-8c72-ebc30d20d7d8#AC4). Copy is written long before it goes out and a capability can slip between the two, so "is this still true" belongs at the moment the claim becomes live. A version describing a capability as available is refused when the feature-dependency record says it is roadmap, in_development or not_planned.

THE PREVIOUS PUBLISHED VERSION IS RETAINED. What was sent last month stays readable, which is the whole reason versions exist.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Publishing an unknown template version is refused
NEGATIVE: a version that is not a positive integer is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: version must be a positive integer
This copy describes a capability as available, but it is recorded otherwise
errorCases.when: the version claims a feature that the dependency record says is not available. A template may not promise a capability the product does not have.

errorCases.message: Only Revenue Operations may publish a template
errorCases.when: a Rep attempts to publish. They may use approved copy and may not alter it.

errorCases.message: No template version with that id and version
errorCases.when: the template or version does not exist.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
